subject.title: fix: doctor repairs Voice Call SQLite schema upgrades

question: Should the doctor-only Plugin SDK permanently expose the raw state-schema detector, repair function, and migration-kind type for plugin-owned alternate state roots?
rationale: The runtime repair is technically coherent, but Plugin SDK additions and persistent-schema operations are compatibility-sensitive public contracts whose permanent shape requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the doctor contract
options.body: Keep these exports because plugins own alternate state roots while core must remain the sole schema-migration implementation.

options.title: Expose one higher-level operation
options.body: Replace the raw functions and migration union with a purpose-built doctor repair helper returning presentation-ready results.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor contract
recommendation.body: Keep these exports because plugins own alternate state roots while core must remain the sole schema-migration implementation.
